question: How many liters of water can a hemispherical tank of radius 2.1 m contain? (Take pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Formula used:**

The volume of the hemispherical tank = 2/3πr³.

**Calculation:**

The amount of water will be, 

⇒ 2/3× π × (2.1)³ 

⇒ 2/3 × 22/7 × 2.1 × 2.1 × 2.1 = 19.404 m³

⇒ 19404 liter

**∴ The correct option is 4**
